value.rationale: Every facet cardinality is independently realizable as the sole upper inball contact orbit, with exactly n+binom(n,k) tangent facets and exponential middle-rank contact multiplicity, despite identical stellohedral combinatorics for b1>1. This is a structurally distinct phase phenomenon absent from the two-parameter result, and the exact radius/center make the transition computable; the statement does not depend on prospective downstream work.
